personal_info.name: Mahmoud E. Murad
personal_info.tagline: Product-minded lead developer building Flutter apps, APIs, dashboards, and launch-ready mobile products.
personal_info.summary: Product-minded Flutter and Backend Developer with 3+ years of experience owning mobile products end to end, from architecture and API design through UI implementation, deployment, and post-launch iteration. Lead Developer at Qatfa Code, delivering client software across e-commerce, healthcare, fitness, on-demand marketplaces, and POS systems. Comfortable designing REST APIs and databases with Node.js, Express, Prisma, PostgreSQL, and Supabase, alongside Flutter, Firebase, and native Kotlin work.

experience.description: Own client mobile and web products end to end, including requirements, architecture, backend and API design, Flutter implementation, deployment, and iteration. Led AROX with a Node.js REST API, real-time bidding/chat, and commission billing, and built Mazid Mart with Flutter and Supabase.

Developed and maintained cross-platform mobile applications for clients across iOS and Android. Collaborated with design and backend teams to deliver polished UI, API integrations, and production apps including Eldalel, Nottr, AL Melhem, PharmaShop, Meras Gym, and AlShateer.
Built and maintained scalable mobile and web applications, including the Request on-demand app suite for client, store, and order management using Flutter, MVVM, GetX, and FCM.
Designed and delivered a Flutter curriculum covering Dart, state management, API integration, and real-world project workflows.
Delivered specialized Flutter training on advanced topics including state management, clean architecture, and production patterns.

experience.role: Flutter Instructor and Head of Community
experience.description: Led the Flutter community track, providing technical training and mentoring to university students.
Volunteered to develop faculty workflow systems that improved administrative processes through mobile technology.
